args: $dir = (Get-Location).Path; $script = $null; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 8 -and -not $script; $i++) { foreach ($rel in @('windows\sign-test.ps1','src-tauri\windows\sign-test.ps1','clients\desktop\src-tauri\windows\sign-test.ps1')) { $cand = Join-Path $dir $rel; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cand) { $script = $cand; break } }; if ($script) { break }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dir; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $dir) { break }; $dir = $parent }; if (-not $script) { throw 'sign-test.ps1 was not found' }; & $script '%1'
